title: Marking Off Pipe Work
objective: Understand the purpose of marking-off information and why it must correspond with controlled drawings and templates.
safety_boundary: Theory and recognition only; no practical marking, cutting or fabrication procedure.

sections.heading: 1. Marking-off purpose
sections.body: Marking-off communicates specified reference information from controlled drawings or templates to fabrication work.

sections.heading: 2. References
sections.body: Dimensions, lines and reference points must correspond with the approved job information.

sections.heading: 3. Accuracy
sections.body: Incorrect transferred information can affect later fabrication and quality, so verification matters.

sections.heading: 4. Stop and refer
sections.body: Conflicting or unclear dimensions must be resolved before practical work proceeds.
